title: Modern Treasury
description: Crisp fintech light: a white page with near-black ink headings and square ink buttons, very pale tinted surfaces (warm stone, paper, blush, aqua, mint) for cards and panels, a sparing bank green for marks and active states, pale mint highlights, and a deep forest-green footer. A tight neo-grotesk with a technical mono. Dark sibling: the forest green as the page, mint buttons.
notes: Host Grotesk stands in for the original's closed neo-grotesk (headings and body), IBM Plex Mono for its mono
surfaces: card = warm stone, muted = paper, popover = blush, secondary = aqua, accent = mint tint
the .dark set is also used as a dark island (the footer carries the dark class)
name: moderntreasury-theme
